claim.final_text:
I added the contact Tove Lindgren, not linked to any third party. Her job position is Purchasing lead, her business phone is 555-0202 and her email is t.lindgren@example.invalid.

I checked it in the app. The contact's edit form shows all five values as entered, and the contact list now has four records with exactly one Tove Lindgren. The other three (Oskar Brandt, Samir Haddad, Elena Novak) look the same as before I started. I left every other field untouched.

The list and the contact's page show her phone as 5550202, without the hyphen. The three existing contacts display their phones the same way, so this is just how the app formats phone numbers on screen.

I didn't see the contact's id and had no address bar to read the URL from.

RESULT: DONE Contact "Tove Lindgren" created (Contacts/Addresses list); id not visible in the interface
